name: City of Safranbolu
description: Safranbolu is a town in northern Türkiye, about 200 km north of Ankara, whose old quarter sits in a deep ravine. Once a stop for caravans on the great East–West trade route, it still has hundreds of Ottoman houses and mansions, along with mosques, bathhouses and caravanserais, some dating to 1322. Its name comes from the saffron once grown here.
